title: Adjustment Disorder - Common Case Patterns and Red Flags
content:
DOCUMENT TYPE: Case Patterns

PATIENT-LANGUAGE EXAMPLES: "I was managing fine until the company announced layoffs", "Since my mother died I just can't get back to normal", "The move across country has me completely unraveling".

COMMON PATTERNS: Job loss or role change, relationship breakup or divorce, serious medical diagnosis in self or family, geographic relocation, legal or financial crisis. Symptoms peak 1-3 months post-stressor and improve with support or problem resolution.

RED FLAGS: Suicidal ideation, substance escalation, inability to work or care for children, emergence of hallucinations or severe dissociation. These warrant immediate re-evaluation for MDD, PTSD, or other disorders.

PROVENANCE: Clinical case literature and DSM-5-TR text.
